query:
SELECT a.id AS "id!", a.claim
            FROM assertions a
            JOIN assertion_groups g
                ON g.id = a.group_id
            JOIN changesets c
                ON c.id = g.changeset_id
            WHERE
                a.data_source_id = ?
                AND a.rel_path = ?
                AND a.retracted_at IS NULL
                AND c.state = 'accepted'
